title: Pax Mini Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The PAX Mini offers the high-end features of a traditional PAX device at a fraction of the size. These pocket-sized flower devices provide a 22-second heat-up time and over two hours of continuous battery life on a single charge. Simple one-button controls and an easy-to-clean design make the mini a must-have vaporizer for your collection.

Product Features:
– Simple one-button controls
– 22-second heat-up time
– Removable 3D oven screen for easy cleaning
– Magnetic oven lid
– Over two hours of continuous battery life on a single charge

What’s Included:
1 x PAX Mini Vaporizer
1 x Flat Mouthpiece
1 x Raised Mouthpiece
1 x Oven Lid
1 x Charge Cable
